title: Cantilever matrix test activation
objective: Replace the cantilever benchmark stub with active original-scope matrix tests.

plan_assets.asset_description: Phase E3 matrix coverage and acceptance criteria.

scope: Activate TL/UL x SVK/Neo-Hookean x Hex8/Tet10/Hex20 cantilever tests.
Use smoke settings locally and preserve nightly/full settings.
Assert tip displacement against beam theory tolerance.
implementation_steps: Replace pytest.skip coverage in the cantilever matrix test.
Use public cantilever runner with smoke/nightly configuration split.
Record any nightly-only full mesh settings in the test comments or fixtures.
Run cantilever and related benchmark tests.
acceptance_criteria: Full original cantilever matrix is represented by active tests.
Tip displacement stays within planned tolerance against beam theory.
Existing Phase 10 benchmark tests still pass.
risks: The full 12-cell matrix may be too expensive for local execution; mitigate with smoke settings and nightly-only full settings.
completion_notes: Activated the TL/UL x SVK/Neo-Hookean x Hex8/Tet10/Hex20 matrix test.
The matrix uses local smoke mesh settings and asserts tip displacement against the Euler-Bernoulli target.
CantileverParameters.nightly() records the full 40x8x4 mesh settings for future nightly harness use.
